status: Admitted as explicitly owned diagnostic; arithmetic and dimensions pass. Not a forecast probability or standalone recommendation.
method: Rebuilt annual server revenue from baseline 2026 level and separately frozen unit/ASP paths. Rebuilt profit, early capital-cohort depreciation, post2030 host capital/DA with unchanged packaging residual, WC, finite credit collections and basis loss, closing cash, and valuations independently from source policies.

checks.early_depreciation_effect: Early cut cohorts reduce D&A; EBIT rises by the opposite amount and D&A addback falls by the same amount. Their pretax operating cash effect cancels, leaving the lost tax shield once. Capex cash savings remain separate.
checks.post2030_depreciation_effect: Post2030 decremental EBIT includes D&A normalization by policy; no second EBIT adjustment is added. New D&A is used once in addback and once in gross replacement capex, cancelling from net investment as intended. This is an aggregate normalization, not a PP&E cohort rollforward.
checks.AMIC: 2028–2030 host capital reductions applied to corresponding eligible basis in proportion to original host capex. Cash collection uses prior-year reduced basis; full-credit basis loss charged at 21% once in origin year. 2031–2032 eligible basis remains unchanged by policy.
checks.liquidity: All modeled year-end cash balances through 2031 remain positive; tax-benefit claims remain below modeled operating tax capacity. Cash income and debt policy are inherited approximations.
checks.growth: All tested operating dimensions grow exactly 3% from 2040 to 2041; credit income is zero in both years.

qualifications: The external_revenue_B field is the inherited model sales denominator, not a fully reconciled GAAP consolidated external revenue forecast. Use the corrected label in presentation.

Early 8-year cohort depreciation is replaced in 2031 by aggregate D&A/revenue normalization. This is explicitly disclosed policy; it does not reconstruct the depreciation of surviving physical equipment.
This stress permanently lowers server revenue level and preserves baseline growth after 2030; it is not a temporary cyclical downturn with full catch-up.
Capex, decremental margin, cash-income budgets and credit eligibility are judgments. The audit checks implementation, not whether these are most likely.
Existing mature_margin_addendum fields in the copied rows are inherited lineage metadata, not extra inputs to add again.
